snippet.title: Active Matter — Release Date Announcement Teaser | Steam, Xbox Series X|S, PS5
snippet.description:
🔥http://amatter.me/steam_wl — Wishlist Now!
🔥https://www.xbox.com/games/store/active-matter/9mz1sk7h6lb6
🔥https://store.playstation.com/concept/10016388

The Early Version of Active Matter was extensively tested on Gaijin.Net, and we’d like to thank the first explorers of our Multiverse. Your feedback was crucial in making the game better!

The latest major update — featuring a decaying American city, new weapons, and more — arrives in a few days, and after the September full game launch, regular updates will bring even more new content and open doors to new parts of the Multiverse, teeming with anomalies and monsters designed to bend your perception of reality.

Thank you for waiting, and let’s get ready for launch!

• Site — https://activematter.game/
• Facebook — https://www.facebook.com/ActiveMatterOfficial/
• Instagram — https://www.instagram.com/active.matter.official
